headword: {新興宗教|しんこうしゅうきょう}
reading: しんこうしゅうきょう

definitions.gloss: new religious movement; new religion; newly established religious group
definitions.explanation: A religious organization founded in relatively recent times, typically from the 19th century onward. In Japan, the term covers a wide range of groups from mainstream organizations with millions of members to smaller, controversial sects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新興宗教|しんこうしゅうきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many new religious movements in Japan.

examples.japanese: {新興宗教|しんこうしゅうきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勧誘|かんゆう}→勧誘：16850_kanyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{断|ことわ}った→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧。
examples.english: I was approached by a new religious group to join, but I declined.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幕末|ばくまつ}→幕末：12531_bakumatsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧⟦にかけて→〜にかけて：30530_nikakete⟧、{社会不安|しゃかいふあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新興宗教|しんこうしゅうきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{誕生|たんじょう}→誕生：01460_tanjou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: From the end of the Edo period into the Meiji era, many new religions were born against a backdrop of social unrest.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{新興|しんこう}→新興：00457_shinkou⟧ (newly risen, emerging) and ⟦{宗教|しゅうきょう}→宗教：03208_shuukyou⟧ (religion). Japan has an unusually rich landscape of new religious movements, with major waves of founding in the late Edo/early Meiji period and again after World War II.

USAGE:
The term is descriptive but can carry negative connotations in casual speech, especially after high-profile incidents involving certain groups. The more neutral academic term is {新宗教|しんしゅうきょう}. Well-known examples include {天理教|てんりきょう}, {創価学会|そうかがっかい}, and {大本|おおもと}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新興宗教|しんこうしゅうきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信者|しんじゃ}→信者：11565_shinja⟧: followers of a new religion
- {新興宗教|しんこうしゅうきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勧誘|かんゆう}→勧誘：16850_kanyuu⟧: solicitation by a new religious group
- {新興宗教|しんこうしゅうきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入信|にゅうしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to convert to a new religion
- {新興宗教|しんこうしゅうきょう}⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧: new religious organization

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新宗教|しんしゅうきょう}: new religion — the academic, more neutral term preferred by scholars of religion
- ⟦カルト→カルト：12829_karuto⟧: cult — a borrowed English term with strongly negative connotations, implying dangerous or manipulative practices
- {既成宗教|きせいしゅうきょう}: established religion — traditional religions like Buddhism and Shinto, in contrast to newer movements
- {宗教法人|しゅうきょうほうじん}: religious corporation — the legal status that religious groups can obtain in Japan
